history.why: The only mover in this spec is in an old-style animate block, which the loop's mover check (_has_authored_mover) can't see, so the loop treats the room as having no mover. Adding a motion block to the same bounded pool on the left fixes that: the pool gets a visibly rippled surface in the still and a matching short motion prompt. The runner matches this to the existing still_flood element by its at value ("to the left" hits still_flood before flood_door) and merges rather than replaces, so the old animate block stays for the player.

The new 3072x1024 scene.png (made 2026-09-17 22:48, after cycle 3 added the mover) shows the pool on the left with wide ripple rings and wavering amber reflections, and the motion prompt describes that same movement; the only clip on disk is from 2026-09-01 and the gate report is empty, so no clip exists for this still yet.
The seed-4242 clip rendered from the new rippled-pool still passed the camera, glitch and dead gates cleanly, so it is queued for Lucas to judge; that is not acceptance.
